notes.title: Quick update 2!
notes.notes:
Here's another quick update, fixing a bunch of issues people have reported!

Issues addressed:
- fixed issue where the crew would be completely healed after loading a game
- when on a lifeboat player can't attack anymore
- blueprints are now correctly unlocked on the shipwright menu when loading a game
- added save option to the in game menu
- fixed crash related to user having save paths with non ascii characters (windows)
- fixed issue where it was possible to spawn in a lifeboat with 0 crew members

notes.title: Quick update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys & gals,

I've just uploaded a first update fixing a few of the crashes reported by the users so far. The complete list of changes is:

- blueprints progress is now saved correctly
- skill points cost is now displayed on the top right of skill rank to purchase
- fixed crash related to selling/scraping ships
- fixed crash related to trying to board a ship and it would suddenly start to sink
- move log.txt to user folder
- removed F1 quick exit
